Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:65140 Court No. - 68 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 7008 of 2024 Applicant :- Morpal Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Krishna Gopal,Virendra Kumar Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1. Supplementary affidavit filed in Court today, is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.
3.

The present third bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No.
608/2021, under Sections 376, 506 IPC, police station Hafizganj, District Bareilly with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
The first and second bail applications of applicant were rejected by this Court vide orders dated 18.05.2022 and 29.03.2023.

Morpal vs State Of U.P. on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163523804/
1 4.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
As per prosecution version, on 27.12.2021 while the prosecutrix was working at her land, applicant-accused caught her and committed rape upon her.
It was submitted that prosecutrix is a 40 years old mature and married lady.
In medical examination report, no injury has been shown on the body of prosecutrix.
Statement of prosecutrix has already been recorded before the trial court and thus, there is no possibility of tampering with the evidence.
Criminal history of two cases shown against the applicant has duly been explained in the affidavit filed in support of the application.

5. It was further submitted that the second bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 29.03.2023 and while rejecting the second bail application of applicant, the trial court was directed to expedite the trial and to conclude the same within a period of eight months but the trial has not been concluded so far.
The case is at the stage of defence evidence.
Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 28.12.2021 and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
6. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the instant third bail application is hereby allowed.

8. Let the applicant Morpal involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
9. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 15.4.2024 Anand  Morpal vs State Of U.P. on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163523804/
